title: PR #31: feat: enforce validator-weighted L1 finality
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Closes the next L1 consensus gap: votes now require registered validators, and canonical finality is stake-weighted at 2/3. The legacy count-based API remains for compatibility; Node exposes finalize_weighted for the canonical path. Includes deterministic tests for threshold and unregistered-vote rejection.
